table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Date=LastUpdate, 
	LogDate=LogDate,
	Item = (SELECT ITEM.name FROM ITEM WHERE ICode = I.ICode),
	CustomICode, Name,
	Class=(SELECT C.Name FROM ItemClass C WHERE C.IcCode = I.IcCode),
	ActualCategory=(SELECT C.Name FROM ItemCategory C WHERE C.ICatCode IN (SELECT IT.ICatCode FROM Item IT WHERE IT.ICode = I.ICode) ),
	Category=(SELECT C.Name FROM ItemCategory C WHERE C.ICatCode = I.ICatCode), 
	Packing=(SELECT P.Name FROM ItemPacking P WHERE P.Packcode = I.Packcode),
	Manufacturer=(SELECT M.Name FROM Manufacturer M WHERE M.ManfCode = I.ManfCode),
	Godown=(SELECT G.Name FROM Godown G WHERE G.Gcode = I.Gcode), 
	SalePrice, 
	PurPrice,
	SalesTax, 
	PackUnits, 
	SaleDiscPerc,
	PurDiscPerc, 
	Active, 
	Printable,
	SalePrice2, SalePrice3,   
	Restricted, GSTPerc1, GSTPerc2, PackSalesTax,
	UserName=(SELECT U.username FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = I.UserCode),
	ICode,
	ItemRowID,
	ChangeReason,
	Module
FROM
(SELECT
	ItemLog.*
FROM 
	ItemLog 
WHERE 
	logdate >= :ad_startdate AND 
	logdate <= :ad_enddate AND 
	ICode IN (SELECT ICode FROM Item WHERE ICatCode IN (:ai_icatcode))
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	ItemLog.*
FROM
	ItemLog
WHERE 
	itemrowid IN 
		(select min(itemrowid) 
		from itemlog 
		where logdate >= :ad_enddate AND 
			ICode IN (SELECT ICode FROM Item WHERE ICatCode IN (:ai_icatcode)))) I
ORDER BY
	ICode, ItemRowID
table.sort: actualcategory A, item A, icode A, itemrowid A
